description: Return the complete Configuration Envelope of a product class in one call: supportsSetupModel, every supports* and perSurfaceSupports* predicate with resolved labels, plus typical* descriptors. This is the full menu of what can be configured for the product — use it before composing a configuration, instead of many individual ptpge_get_term calls. Absent predicates mean NOT supported (closed semantics).
name: ptpge_get_product_envelope
title: Product envelope
